title: Technical Candidate Vetting & Team Screening
summary: Protect your company from $50k+ hiring mistakes with 90-minute architecture scenario interviews and blunt Pass/Fail scorecards.

problem.headline: Costly Hiring Mistakes & Unvetted Resumes
points: Non-technical founders making expensive $50k–$150k+ bad engineering hires.
Inability to evaluate candidate database knowledge, concurrency control, or code quality.
Recruiter screenings failing to detect smooth talkers with zero production depth.

approach.headline: 90-Minute Architecture Scenarios & Blunt Scorecards
points: Design real-world architecture scenarios matching the client's actual tech stack.
Conduct a live 90-minute technical interview probing database locks, API boundaries, and trade-offs.
Deliver a blunt Pass/Fail scorecard with explicit Hire/No-Hire recommendations.

deliverables: 3-Page Candidate Technical Scorecard with domain risk analysis

pricing.anchorText: Per-Candidate Screening Fee or Monthly Retainer
